purpose: Predeclared evaluation of two proposed globe estimate layers (research/globe/README.md sections 1-7): the MRMS 3D reflectivity volume and the GOES ACHA cloud-top deck. It replaces the Phase 3 acceptance ('voxels ... line up with SPC reports within 5 km'), which two reviewers judged invalid: SPC reports are local, after-the-fact filings, not ground truth for radar volumes. It asks whether the app draws what the sources contain and whether freshness, can't-tell and estimate labels are read correctly. It makes no hail claim. It ties to the review P0 baseline and docs/ROADMAP.md item 3. Frozen 2026-10-17, before any held-out frame is decoded or shown to a participant; any change needs a new version and a stated reason. SPC 2025-06-15 (Benchland, 1.75 in) is the known example in ROADMAP item 4 and globe Phase 3, so it is excluded from all held-out cases. Research only; nothing ships.
what_is_being_evaluated: the 3D reflectivity volume product (crop/threshold/voxelisation) as a faithful rendering of MRMS — NOT hail accuracy
the cloud-top-height deck as a faithful rendering of ACHA
comprehension: do users read freshness, can't-tell and estimate labels correctly

metrics.name: voxel_dbz_mismatch
metrics.definition: Rendered voxels whose dBZ differs from the decoded source cell (same time, level, lat, lon) after a rounding rule fixed in advance (nearest 0.5 dBZ). Every frame in each held-out window; every cell of the declared crop.
metrics.unit: count; max absolute error in dBZ
metrics.computed_from: Voxel dump from headless Chromium vs decoded MRMS MergedReflectivityQC GRIB2.
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: PASS: 0 mismatches. Any mismatch fails the layer.

metrics.name: no_data_rendered_as_echo_or_clear
metrics.definition: Cells holding either no-data code (-99 or -999 in the bucket files; which one means no echo and which means no coverage is not yet settled, see data_needed) rendered as echo or as clear. Also mask cells with no source behind them, and no-data cells not shown as a non-clear state.
metrics.computed_from: Source codes vs rendered state, per frame and level.
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: PASS: 0 such cells; mask fraction 1.000; 0 extra mask cells.

metrics.name: threshold_count_parity
metrics.definition: Rendered voxels at or above 20, 35 and 50 dBZ (>= inclusive), per frame and level, minus the numpy count on the same source crop.
metrics.computed_from: Rendered counts vs numpy counts on the decoded grid.

metrics.name: crop_and_level_integrity
metrics.definition: Rendered cells outside the declared crop box; in-box source cells omitted; levels whose height differs from GRIB2 metadata (33 levels; bucket directory names are a cross-check only).
metrics.computed_from: Rendered cell indices and level list vs declared box and GRIB2 inventory.
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: PASS: all counts 0; height reference recorded in the run manifest.

metrics.name: frame_time_error
metrics.definition: Displayed valid time minus the file's own valid time (file-name UTC stamp, checked against GRIB2 reference time). Retrieval time is shown separately, never as valid time.
metrics.computed_from: DOM label vs file name and GRIB2 reference time.

metrics.name: decision_time_leaks
metrics.definition: Frames displayed in replay that use a source not yet published at display time. Availability is the object's LastModified (or the poll log). Repo evidence says LastModified runs 35-99 s after valid time per level, so using valid time as availability is a leak.
metrics.computed_from: Replay display log joined to the poll log of bucket listings.

metrics.name: missing_slot_shown_as_gap
metrics.definition: Share of absent expected slots (MRMS 2-minute cycle; ACHAC 5-minute scan) shown as a gap or age label, not interpolated or carried forward.
metrics.computed_from: Slot list from bucket listings vs rendered timeline.

metrics.name: acha_height_error
metrics.definition: Max absolute difference on valid pixels between displayed cloud-top height and file HT converted by a declared unit rule (units read from the file). Count of pixels with invalid DQF or fill that display a height.
metrics.unit: metres or declared display unit; count
metrics.computed_from: Rendered height grid vs HT, DQF and fill in each ACHAC file.
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: PASS: error within declared display rounding on all valid pixels; invalid-pixel count 0.

metrics.name: acha_geolocation_error
metrics.definition: 95th percentile distance between rendered deck pixels and positions from the file's fixed-grid projection (sub-satellite longitude read from the file). Any parallax correction is named on screen.
metrics.computed_from: Rendered vertices vs projection of each pixel centre.

metrics.name: acha_time_and_satellite
metrics.definition: Displayed time minus the scan-start field in the filename; satellite label (G18 or G19) vs the file's platform attribute.
metrics.computed_from: DOM labels vs filenames and attributes.

metrics.name: freshness_reading_accuracy
metrics.definition: Share of participants who state the fresh (3 min) and stale (22 min) fixtures' age within 5 min and call them Live and Stale correctly.
metrics.computed_from: Closed answers in the comprehension test.

metrics.name: estimate_label_recognition
metrics.definition: Share who classify each layer as base map, satellite estimate or radar estimate, using the labels the build shows.
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: PASS: >= 0.90 per layer with n >= 20; else report-only.

metrics.name: false_all_clear
metrics.definition: Share who read a 'No radar coverage' area, or a 'Data unavailable' storm layer, as clear of storms.
metrics.computed_from: Answers to the two can't-tell items.
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: PASS: 0 among >= 20 participants. Any single one triggers redesign before release.

metrics.name: overreach
metrics.definition: Share who say the volume shows hail on a roof, a hail size or damage, or who read the cloud deck as cloud base. Two blind raters; a third resolves disagreements; agreement reported.
metrics.computed_from: Closed answers plus the coded open answer.
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: PASS: <= 0.05 for each item. Any damage claim triggers redesign.

metrics.name: local_time_reading
metrics.definition: Share who convert the newest frame's UTC valid time to job local time (Mountain Daylight Time in summer) within 1 minute.

metrics.name: archive_gap_rate
metrics.definition: Share of expected slots absent from the archive in each held-out window (example: 283 of 288 GOES-19 ACHAC objects on 2025-07-28 UTC).
metrics.pass_threshold_or_report_only: REPORT-ONLY: an archive property, not an app defect.

fidelity_checks: Every frame in each held-out window: each rendered voxel's dBZ equals the decoded source cell at the same time, level, lat and lon after the declared rounding (zero mismatches).
Cells holding either no-data code never render as echo or as clear; they render as a non-clear mask. Keeping no-echo and no-coverage apart waits on the code meanings in data_needed.
Threshold counts (20, 35, 50 dBZ, inclusive) equal numpy counts on the same crop, per frame and level; zero difference required.
No rendered cell outside the declared crop; no in-crop source cell omitted; the crop box is written to the run manifest before the run.

The level set equals the file's 33 levels (0.25 km steps to 3 km, 0.5 km to 9 km, 1 km to 19 km), with heights from GRIB2 metadata and the height reference recorded. A frame is shown only when all 33 levels share its valid time; partial frames are shown as partial.
Displayed valid time equals the file's valid time; retrieval time is shown separately and never as valid time.
Replay shows each frame only after its source is published (LastModified, or the poll log), never by valid time alone.
Absent MRMS 2-minute slots and ACHAC 5-minute scans render as gaps; no interpolation or carry-forward without an age label.
Colour bins match the legend intervals; the boundary rule (>= at 20, 35, 50 dBZ) is the same in the legend, colour lookup and counts. Any downsampling is max-in-block, never mean.

ACHA: height equals file HT (units read from the file) on valid pixels only; pixels with invalid DQF or fill show no height; each pixel sits at its fixed-grid position within 0.5 source pixels; displayed time equals the scan-start field; the satellite label matches the platform attribute.
No DEMO footprint, test fixture or synthetic frame enters an evaluation run (AGENTS rule 5); dBZ is never converted to hail size, rain rate or damage in the render.

held_out_cases.how_to_pick: Rule fixed now: SPC days (12:00 UTC to 11:59 UTC next day) with >= 5 Montana hail rows and >= 2 at 1.75 in or more, excluding 2025-06-15. Six qualify: 250613, 250614, 250620, 250721, 250728, 250807. The three chosen span south-central, eastern and Billings-area reports; alternates 250614 and 250807.
held_out_cases.candidate: 2025-06-13 (SPC 250613): 10 Montana hail rows, largest 2.75 in (1 NNW Pryor, 0110 UTC on 06-14), 4 rows at 1.75 in or more. Window data: MRMS 720 + 720 frames; ACHAC 287 (G18) and 286 (G19) on 06-13, 288 and 288 on 06-14.

2025-06-20 (SPC 250620): 5 Montana hail rows, largest 2.50 in (Powderville, Ekalaka, 8 NNE Belltower), 4 at 1.75 in or more; eastern Montana. Three of the five rows cite Facebook reports, so they are weak ground truth. Window data: MRMS 720 + 720; ACHAC 288 and 288 on 06-20, 287 and 288 on 06-21.

Window data: MRMS 720 + 720; ACHAC 285 (G18) and 283 (G19) on 07-28, 287 and 288 on 07-29, so this day carries built-in gaps.

held_out_cases.how_to_pick: Search set: the 99 Montana hail rows on the 25 non-development days. After the MRMS pull, take the first row in time order whose largest column reflectivity (over the 33 levels) in any cell within 5 km stays below 35 dBZ for the window 15 minutes before to 15 minutes after the report. Chosen on echo, so this is a label stress case, never an accuracy sample. If none qualifies, record 'no qualifying case'.
held_out_cases.candidate: Not picked; needs the MRMS pull. No row has been checked against radar yet.

Great-circle distance from NCEI coordinates; beam centre at the 0.5-degree tilt with standard refraction. Out-of-state radars are not in the set; MRMS's own no-coverage code decides.

held_out_cases.how_to_pick: A Montana date from 2025-12-01 to 2026-02-28 with an NWS winter-weather product over a saved place, MRMS column maximum >= 20 dBZ over that place, and no SPC Montana hail row. Pick from the NWS and MRMS archives after the rule is fixed.
held_out_cases.candidate: None picked; not checked in this pass. The case tests that snow or ice echo is labelled a radar estimate with no hail wording, and that ACHA over snow is not read as clear sky.

spc_day_rule: 12:00-11:59 UTC, from D13 (file YYMMDD holds the window from 12:00 UTC on YYMMDD to 11:59 UTC the next day, per SPC's 250615 page: 'The Storm Reports page is organized based on reports received from 1200 UTC to 1159 UTC the next day' and 'All Times UTC'. The CSV Time column is UTC HHMM with no date; comment text can hold local times and is not used for timing. The older SPC 'Midnight to 11:59pm CDT' wording describes a calendar day and is not used.)

comprehension_test.method: Moderated or unmoderated, one session per participant, on the real build in headless Chromium (AGENTS rule 8). At least 20 pilot crew and office staff who will use the page, reported apart from anyone who built it. Six fixed screens built from synthetic fixtures in a harness labelled 'TEST FIXTURE - NOT WEATHER' (never shown in the app; AGENTS rule 5): newest radar frame 3 min old (Live); frame 22 min old (Stale, past the D12 15-minute radar limit); a 'No radar coverage' area; a storm layer labelled 'Data unavailable'; a legend with layer labels as the build shows them; the job time zone beside UTC. Closed questions first, no hints; then one open question; two blind raters.
questions: How old is the newest radar frame on this screen, and is that layer Live or Stale?
What time does this radar frame describe, and when was it downloaded?
The area labelled 'No radar coverage' shows no storms. Can you say it is clear?
The storm layer says 'Data unavailable'. Can you say there are no storms there?
Which layer is a satellite estimate, which is a radar estimate, and which is only a base map?
Does the storm volume show that hail reached a roof?
Does the cloud deck show where the cloud base is?
What local time is the newest frame in the job's time zone?
Open: in one sentence, what can this view tell a crew about roof damage?
comprehension_test.pass: Report-first. Each closed item >= 0.90 correct with Wilson 95% CI reported (n >= 20; report-only below that). Zero false all-clear answers to questions 3 and 4; any one triggers redesign. Overreach at <= 0.05 for questions 6 and 7. Local time >= 0.90. Coder agreement reported. Any label change restarts the test.

what_this_evaluation_does_not_claim: Hail detection, hail size, footprint or MESH accuracy (no POD, FAR or size error). SPC reports only choose days and are never voxel ground truth, so the 'within 5 km' check is not used.
Damage, roof condition, insurance eligibility or a damage probability (AGENTS rule 5; DECISIONS D17).
That no echo means clear air. Far from the radars the low levels are unsampled (DECISIONS D24), so 'No radar coverage' is a mask, not an all-clear.
Any cloud base. The cloud-top deck shows the top surface only.
That MRMS or ACHA is accurate, best or better than another source (AGENTS rule 9).
Latency, server load, laptop performance or frame bytes (globe plan Phase 5, outside this evaluation).
Anything beyond the people tested, the held-out days and the sites chosen; no other-state or population claim.
Physical content of the radar volume (for example, that a 0.5 km value is right at a roof). This evaluation checks rendering and labels only; winter precipitation type is not evaluated.
data_needed_and_where: MRMS 3D: s3://noaa-mrms-pds/CONUS/MergedReflectivityQC_{00.50 ... 19.00}/YYYYMMDD/ (us-east-1). The 33 level directories were listed 2026-10-17; each candidate date has 720 files at the 00.50 level. Repo evidence research/globe/validation-evidence/mrms.json (untracked in the working tree; re-decode before use) reports a 7000 x 3500 grid at 0.01 degrees, GRIB2 heights in metres with typeOfLevel heightAboveSea (MSL), and 16-bit reflectivity. Code meanings are not settled: that file calls both -99 and -999 'no data', but its shares by level (CONUS at 00.50: -999 93%, -99 7%; at 10.00: -999 35%, -99 64%) fit -999 = no coverage and -99 = no echo. Confirm from primary NOAA/NSSL documentation.
MRMS 2D cross-check (optional): CONUS/MergedReflectivityQCComposite_00.50/ in the same bucket.

GOES ACHA: s3://noaa-goes18/ABI-L2-ACHAC/YYYY/DDD/HH/ (GOES-West) and s3://noaa-goes19/ (GOES-East). 2025 summer objects are present in both. Read HT, DQF, the fill value and goes_imager_projection from the files. Units conflict: repo evidence says metres (scale 0.3052037); the NESDIS caption says feet.
SPC: https://www.spc.noaa.gov/climo/reports/YYMMDD_rpts_filtered_{hail,wind,torn}.csv. Hail files for all 92 summer days were fetched (HTTP 200). Day page YYMMDD_rpts.html gives the window and UTC.

Radar sites (NCEI station pages): KBLX 45.853778 N, -108.606806, 1128.7 m; KGGW 48.206361 N, -106.624694, 726.7 m; KTFX 47.459583 N, -111.385333, 1159.7 m; KMSX 47.041 N, -113.986222, 2431.7 m. Out-of-state radars are not checked.
Saved-place coordinates and job time zones from the app database (store.py). Not available in this pass.

Reconcile repo evidence: research/globe/validation-evidence/goes-aws.json says 0 objects dated 2026 and newest ACHAC object 2025/097 (line 113), yet its own entries download 2026/290 files (lines 117-167), and live listings show 2025/166 objects in both buckets. The 2025/097 claim is likely a first-page listing artifact (S3 returns 1000 keys in key order). The globe README sections 8-12 it cites are not in README.md.

Limits conflict: DECISIONS D12 sets radar 15 min and has no GOES or imagery limit; globe README section 3 gives MRMS 10 min and GOES 15 min. D12 also has no satellite-estimate kind for ACHA. Settle both before the run and before the comprehension test.

Replay poll log of first-seen times for every MRMS and ACHAC object; at least 20 participants; a Playwright/Chromium harness (AGENTS rule 8). Local copies: scratchpad w20-spc/ (CSVs) and w20-scripts/ (scan_spc.py, radar_gap.py).

sources_quoted.text: Predeclare metrics — weather misses/false alarms/lead time, review time, interruptions per 100 job-days, findings per crew-hour.
Reporting day = 12:00–11:59 UTC.
Freshness limits: radar 15 min, alerts 10 min, SPC 60 min, forecast 12 h, footprint 6 h.
far from the four Montana radar sites (Billings, Glasgow, Great Falls, Missoula) the beam overshoots low levels, so no echo must keep showing as no data, never as clear
No damage probability, insurance language or “confirmed damage”.
No report is not “no hail.” Missing inputs show “Data unavailable,” never an all-clear.
No “best” claims for any provider or model until the evaluation in docs/ROADMAP.md supports it.
Use event/date-based held-out splits, not random neighboring pixels.
MESH agreement alone is not ground-truth hail verification.
Validate the exact delivered version against its specification; show source age independently from successful retrieval.
Freeze selection/calibration before held-out evaluation; do not blindly average correlated feeds or choose whichever predicts the largest hazard.
Rural absence of hail reports is not a valid negative observation.
